purpose: Defines the 100-byte IMS pending authorization summary root segment PAUTSUM0 (one per account), copied under 01 PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY. It holds the account and customer ids, account status codes, credit and cash limits and balances, and running counts and amounts of approved and declined authorizations. COPAUA0C creates and updates it per authorization, COPAUS0C/COPAUS1C read it for display, CBPAUP0C reduces/deletes it when purging expired details, and PAUDBUNL/DBUNLDGS/PAUDBLOD unload and reload it.

key_fields.name: PA-ACCT-ID
key_fields.meaning: Account id, packed S9(11); segment key (ACCNTID in DL/I WHERE clauses).

key_fields.name: PA-CUST-ID
key_fields.meaning: Customer id from the card cross-reference.

key_fields.name: PA-ACCOUNT-STATUS
key_fields.meaning: Five 2-byte account status codes (OCCURS 5); not set or tested by any batch B01 program.

key_fields.name: PA-CREDIT-LIMIT
key_fields.meaning: Credit limit, refreshed from ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT on each authorization; used for available credit.

key_fields.name: PA-CREDIT-BALANCE
key_fields.meaning: Credit balance including approved pending authorizations; available credit = limit - balance.

key_fields.name: PA-APPROVED-AUTH-CNT
key_fields.meaning: Count of approved pending authorizations (binary S9(4)).

observations.text: Computed length is 100 bytes (6+9+1+10+4x6+2x2+2x6+34), matching PAUDBUNL/PAUDBLOD OPFIL1-REC/INFIL1-REC PIC X(100).
PA-AUTH-STATUS, PA-ACCOUNT-STATUS and PA-CASH-BALANCE (other than being zeroed by COPAUA0C) carry no business logic in the B01 programs.
